result.summary: MSTR stopped at step 0: model_fit is 'not_suitable' because the main asset is bitcoin (approximately 843,775 bitcoins with a market value of $54.14 billion on July 24, 2026), and bitcoin produces no cash flow. For this reason FCFF, ROIC, debt/EBITDA and the DCF do not apply, and the tool gives no margin of safety at $154.34 (close on 2026-10-09). The two main risks in the filings are the debt ($6,670.1 million long-term at 2026-06-30) together with perpetual preferred stock that the extracted data shows as 0, and dilution of 44.2% in 2025. The result changes only with a net asset value method for a holding company.

steps.reason: Strategy Inc (formerly MicroStrategy, SIC 6199) has a fiscal year end of December 31. The data has 10 fiscal years, 2016-12-31 to 2025-12-31; the newest data is the 10-Q for 2026-06-30, filed 2026-08-03 (data_as_of). model_fit is 'not_suitable'. The main asset of the company is bitcoin: on July 24, 2026 it held approximately 843,775 bitcoins with a market value of $54.14 billion, against total assets of $52.56 billion at 2026-06-30. The software business is small: revenue was $477.2 million in 2025 and fell 0.8% per year from 2016. The value of the company depends on the price of bitcoin and on the terms of its debt and preferred stock, not on cash flow from operations. Bitcoin produces no cash flow, so FCFF, ROIC and a DCF do not measure the value. The cover page shows 364,585,501 class A shares and 19,640,250 class B shares on July 24, 2026. The price is $154.34, the regular-session close on 2026-10-09 (sources: finance.yahoo.com/quote/MSTR/history and stockanalysis.com/stocks/mstr/history; both show the same close).

steps.reason: Competence: the business is a bitcoin treasury company with a small enterprise software business; the competence rule passes. Survival: debt-ebitda and interest-coverage are not meaningful because the result of the bitcoin fair-value change makes operating income negative (-$5,444.4 million in 2025). At 2026-06-30 long-term debt was $6,670.1 million, and debt maturities are $4,510.0 million in year 2 and $2,203.7 million in year 3; cash and short-term investments were $2,448.0 million. The extracted preferred stock value is 0, but the 10-Q lists several perpetual preferred series (STRF, STRC, STRK and others) with dividends. For this reason the data understates the claims before the common shares. Because the model does not fit, the survival rules are not scored.

steps.reason: Not done: model_fit is 'not_suitable', so the analysis stopped at step 0. Draft conditions for a future net asset value analysis: (1) bitcoin per diluted share falls for two quarters; (2) the market value of bitcoin falls below two times the debt plus the preferred liquidation preference; (3) the company must issue common shares below net asset value per share to pay preferred dividends. Pre-mortem: three years later the investment lost money because the price of bitcoin fell, because the debt and preferred claims took a larger part of the assets, or because the premium of the share price to the bitcoin value per share disappeared.
